title: Turkish Lamb Kebabs with Cucumber Salad
description: A classic Turkish dish featuring lamb kebabs served with a refreshing cucumber salad. Perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, mix together lamb, 2 cloves of minced garlic, 1 tablespoon olive oil, and 1 teaspoon paprika.
4. Grill lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
5. Meanwhile, slice cucumbers and onions thinly.
6. In a bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and 1 teaspoon salt.
7. Add sliced cucumbers and onions to the bowl, and toss to coat.
8. Serve lamb kebabs with cucumber salad and crusty bread.
